unit.command: dotnet test tests/SharpHDL.UnitTests -c Release -m:1 -nr:false -p:UseSharedCompilation=false --artifacts-path <run>/managed --filter 'FullyQualifiedName~ToolCommandTests|FullyQualifiedName~HdlToolRunnerTests' --collect:'XPlat Code Coverage' --settings tests/SharpHDL.UnitTests/coverage.runsettings --results-directory <run>/latest-coverage
unit.scope: Includes the new registry and existing process-runner regressions. Unexercised campaign code contributes to the assembly denominator.

mcp.command: dotnet test tests/SharpHDL.CommandTests -c Release -m:1 -nr:false -p:UseSharedCompilation=false --artifacts-path <run>/mcp-managed --collect:'XPlat Code Coverage' --results-directory <run>/mcp-coverage
mcp.scope: Actual SDK stdio discovery, schema, malformed argument, literal argv, success, nonzero exit, matching CLI invocation, cancellation and retained manifest. Coverage was collected from the launched adapter.

mutation.scope: ToolCommandRegistry only. The filter excludes real-process registry cases. Remaining survivors affect diagnostic strings and absolute executable resolution. Uncovered mutants affect process-result diagnostics and evidence I/O recovery.

watchdog.enforcement: Existing SharpUnits Invoke-Budgeted.ps1 copied into the run directory. Windows Job Object commit limits and serial admission. No source modifications to that repository.

limitations: No Linux qualification or full repository regression in this slice.
No separate fuzz campaign or new formal proof.
The managed registry and MCP adapter cover only local tool execution.
Normal tool permissions apply. Detached process cleanup and cross-host locking remain outside this slice.
